mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, salt, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, roles, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_account WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT r.role_code FROM t_sys_user_role ur JOIN t_sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND ur.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND ur.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
